visualBrief: The closed Bailey span at Damiyah has paired green steel trusses, a timber deck, concrete abutments and locked gates at both ends.

references.name: bailey
references.observation: Standing bridge with green steel side panels and curved approach.

references.name: close
references.observation: The timber deck, Bailey panel diagonals, galvanized railing and closure across the west end.

references.name: side
references.observation: Faded blue concrete traffic barriers and chain-link fence next to the approach.

limitations: The asset represents the standing Bailey bridge and the identifiable closure hardware at its ends. Adjacent remnants of earlier crossings are outside the placement.
Deck width, steel panel dimensions, barrier details and bearing heights are reconstructed from photographs and standard viewer terrain. The mapped span is tagged closed to access.
